'''July 2008 Minnesota Mini-Open''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG mini-open played on Friday 25 July 2008 at Twin City Comics in Minnesota, the first event of the "Minnesota Super Weekend" organized by [[Garrett Larson]].<ref name="sf-21613-311565">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=311565#p311565 MN Super weekend], deadbody (Garrett Larson), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (1 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125191854/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21613.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Michael Raveling]] won; Garrett Larson, second, took the bye to Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship]].<ref name="sf-21613-318126">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=318126#p318126 MN Super weekend], band_member (Michael Raveling), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (26 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125191854/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21613.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref> It is not the same event as the Minnesota Mini-Open held at Twin City Comics on 27 September 2008.<ref name="pcf-22966-333232">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=333232#333232 MN Mini-Open], deadbody, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (3 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080919091010/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=336374&sid=1211bbf40dcb863be90b6a41acc80db5 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Twin City Comics, Minnesota<ref name="sf-21613-311565" />
* '''Dates:''' 25 July 2008<ref name="sf-21613-311565" />
* '''Time:''' 1 pm<ref name="sf-21613-311565" />
* '''Format:''' decklists required<ref name="sf-21613-311565" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10<ref name="sf-21613-311565" />
* '''Tournament director:''' three-judge system, with [[Garrett Larson]] and two other judges<ref name="sf-21613-311565" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Raveling]]<ref name="sf-21613-318126" />

== Organization ==

Larson announced the Minnesota Super Weekend on 1 July 2008: the mini-open on Friday 25 July with one bye to Worlds, the [[2008 Bespin Regionals|Bespin Regionals]] on Saturday 26 July and the [[2008 Minnesota State Championship|Minnesota State Championship]] on Sunday 27 July, all at Twin City Comics. Prizes were to include trophies, rares, packs and [[tournament foils]], and Larson requested a virtual card for the winner of the weekend, the player with the highest combined finishes in the three events.<ref name="sf-21613-311565" />

== Results ==

Raveling, posting as band_member, gave the top five on the evening of the event.<ref name="sf-21613-318126" />

Larson took the bye for finishing second.<ref name="sf-21613-318126" /> The list of 2008 Worlds Day 2 auto bids that Cedric (simone89) posted gives the event as "July 25th Bespin Region Mini Open Garrett Larson".<ref name="sf-22883-332133" /> Jacobson posted the results of the Friday event, with pictures and video, on his own website.<ref name="sf-21613-318197">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=318197#p318197 MN Super weekend], Jeeps (Peter Jacobson), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (26 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125191854/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21613.html Internet Archive]</ref>
